The corrected batch therefore combines high-ratio tail probes, weak and intermediate controls, nitrogen-containing structures, and ordinary non-donor anchors.","batch_rationale":"The batch uses condition-response probes to identify where retention transitions begin, including high-ratio donor, nitrogen, carbonyl, and non-donor candidates. It also includes weak-condition and neutral controls so the retrained model can learn a structural gate instead of applying a broad PE correction. Several loading amounts and volumes are represented across polar and nitrogen-containing structures, while simple ketones, esters, hydrocarbons, and halogenated aromatics preserve central calibration. This combination targets both rare high-error regions and the majority central Row-distribution, improving transfer of V1/V2 corrections across scaffold and condition space."}
